title: Equivariant Elliptic Index and Character Formula

items.title: Equivariant elliptic-complex index and character
items.statement:
Let $T$ be a compact torus and $M$ a compact smooth manifold without boundary. A smooth left $T$-action is a jointly smooth map $a:T\times M\to M$ with $a(e,x)=x$ and $a(st,x)=a(s,a(t,x))$. Let $E^0,\ldots,E^N$ be finite-rank complex vector bundles on $M$. For each $j<N$, let $d_j:C^\infty(M,E^j)\to C^\infty(M,E^{j+1})$ be a linear differential operator of finite order, and put $d_{-1}=d_N=0$. The sequence is a complex when $d_{j+1}d_j=0$ for every $j$. It is **elliptic** when, for every $x\in M$ and every nonzero real cotangent vector $\xi\in T_x^*M$, the sequence of principal-symbol maps

$$0\longrightarrow E_x^0\xrightarrow{\sigma(d_0)(x,\xi)}E_x^1\xrightarrow{\sigma(d_1)(x,\xi)}\cdots\xrightarrow{\sigma(d_{N-1})(x,\xi)}E_x^N\longrightarrow0$$

is exact. Suppose each bundle has a smooth $T$-linearization $\rho_t^j:E_x^j\to E_{t\cdot x}^j$, satisfying the group-action law, and the induced section maps

$$ (U_t^j s)(x):=\rho_t^j\bigl(s(t^{-1}\cdot x)\bigr) $$

commute with $d_j$. Require the cohomology spaces $H^j(E^\bullet):=\ker d_j/\operatorname{im}d_{j-1}$ to be finite-dimensional. The representation ring $R(T)$ is the Grothendieck ring of finite-dimensional continuous complex representations of $T$. Define

$$\operatorname{Ind}_T(E^\bullet):=\sum_{j=0}^N(-1)^j[H^j(E^\bullet)]\in R(T),\qquad \chi_{E^\bullet}(t):=\sum_{j=0}^N(-1)^j\operatorname{tr}\!\left(U_t^j\bigm|_{H^j(E^\bullet)}\right).$$

For a two-term complex $0\to C^\infty(M,E^+)\xrightarrow{D^+}C^\infty(M,E^-)\to0$, this gives $[\ker D^+]-[\operatorname{coker}D^+]$. This definition concerns elliptic complexes, not transversally elliptic operators.

items.title: Relative tangent-groupoid heat-trace limit at simple fixed points
items.statement:
Let $T$ be a compact torus acting smoothly by isometries on a compact Riemannian manifold $M$ without boundary. Let $E^0,\ldots,E^N$ be finite-rank Hermitian bundles and, for $0\le j<N$, let $d_j:C^\infty(M,E^j)\to C^\infty(M,E^{j+1})$ be first-order differential maps with $d_{j+1}d_j=0$. Assume the principal-symbol sequence is exact for every nonzero real cotangent vector. Suppose smooth unitary bundle maps $\rho_t^j:E_x^j\to E_{t\cdot x}^j$ satisfy $\rho_e^j=I$ and $\rho_{st}^j|_{E_x^j}=\rho_s^j|_{E_{t\cdot x}^j}\circ\rho_t^j|_{E_x^j}$, and commute with all $d_j$; on sections set $(U_t^j s)(y)=\rho_t^j(s(t^{-1}\cdot y))$. Put $d_{-1}=d_N=0$, $E^{\mathrm{ev}}=\bigoplus_{j\text{ even}}E^j$, $E^{\mathrm{odd}}=\bigoplus_{j\text{ odd}}E^j$, $d=\bigoplus_jd_j$, and $\Delta=(d+d^*)^2$, where $d^*$ is the formal adjoint for the chosen metrics and Riemannian volume. Assume that $\Delta$ has discrete nonnegative spectrum, smooth eigensections, a trace-class heat operator $e^{-t\Delta}$ with smooth kernel for every $t>0$, finite-dimensional cohomology, and a harmonic representative for each cohomology class. For $g\in T$, let $M^g=\{x\in M:g\cdot x=x\}$, and suppose each $x\in M^g$ is simple, meaning $I-dg_x:T_xM\to T_xM$ is invertible. Then

$$\lim_{t\downarrow0}\operatorname{Str}(U_g e^{-t\Delta})=\sum_{x\in M^g}\frac{\sum_{j=0}^N(-1)^j\operatorname{tr}(\rho_g^j|_{E_x^j})}{|\det_{\mathbb R}(I-dg_x)|}.$$

Here $\operatorname{Str}$ is the trace on $E^{\mathrm{ev}}$ minus the trace on $E^{\mathrm{odd}}$. The simplicity condition makes $M^g$ a finite set; the determinant is the normal Jacobian at that isolated fixed point.

items.title: Equivariant elliptic-complex index character at simple fixed points
items.statement:
Let $T$ be a compact torus acting smoothly by isometries on a compact smooth manifold $M$ without boundary. Let $E^0,\ldots,E^N$ be finite-rank Hermitian bundles, set $E^{-1}=E^{N+1}=0$ and $d_{-1}=d_N=0$, and for $0\le j<N$ let $d_j:C^\infty(M,E^j)\to C^\infty(M,E^{j+1})$ be first-order differential maps with $d_{j+1}d_j=0$. Assume the principal-symbol sequence is exact for every nonzero real cotangent vector. Suppose smooth unitary bundle maps $\rho_t^j:E_x^j\to E_{t\cdot x}^j$ satisfy $\rho_e^j=I$ and $\rho_{st}^j|_{E_x^j}=\rho_s^j|_{E_{t\cdot x}^j}\circ\rho_t^j|_{E_x^j}$, and commute with all $d_j$. Let $H^j=\ker d_j/\operatorname{im}d_{j-1}$ be finite-dimensional, use $T$-invariant Hermitian metrics and Riemannian volume to form the formal adjoint $d^*$ and $\Delta=(d+d^*)^2$, and assume $\Delta$ has discrete nonnegative spectrum, trace-class heat operators with smooth kernels for $t>0$, and zero eigenspace canonically isomorphic to $\bigoplus_jH^j$. Put $\operatorname{Ind}_T(E^\bullet)=\sum_j(-1)^j[H^j]\in R(T)$, where $R(T)$ is the Grothendieck ring of finite-dimensional continuous complex representations of $T$, and let $\chi_{\operatorname{Ind}_T(E^\bullet)}(g)$ be the alternating trace on these cohomology representations. For $g\in T$, suppose every fixed point $x\in M^g=\{y:g\cdot y=y\}$ is simple, meaning $I-dg_x:T_xM\to T_xM$ is invertible. Then

$$\chi_{\operatorname{Ind}_T(E^\bullet)}(g)=\sum_{x\in M^g}\frac{\sum_{j=0}^N(-1)^j\operatorname{tr}(\rho_g^j|_{E_x^j})}{|\det_{\mathbb R}(I-dg_x)|}.$$

The numerator is the fiber character $\sum_j(-1)^j\operatorname{tr}(\rho_g^j|_{E_x^j})$, equivalently the degree-zero equivariant Chern character of the virtual fiber $\sum_j(-1)^jE_x^j$; the denominator is the isolated fixed point's real normal Jacobian. The formula is asserted only at group elements with simple fixed points.

title: Equivariant Elliptic Index and Character Formula — Examples

items.title: A nontrivial virtual character on a two-point manifold
items.statement: Let $T=\mathbb R/\mathbb Z$ and let $M=\{p,q\}$ be a two-point smooth $0$-manifold with trivial $T$-action. For $k\in\mathbb Z$, let $\mathbb C_k$ be the one-dimensional representation $[s]\mapsto e^{2\pi i k s}$. Take the zero-differential complex whose fibers are $E_p^0=\mathbb C_0\oplus\mathbb C_1$, $E_p^1=\mathbb C_2$, $E_q^0=\mathbb C_1$, and $E_q^1=\mathbb C_0$, with all other fibers zero. Its equivariant index is $2[\mathbb C_1]-[\mathbb C_2]$, with character $2z-z^2$ at $z=e^{2\pi i s}$. Every point is fixed, the tangent determinant is the empty determinant $1$, and the fixed-point sum is also $2z-z^2$.

items.title: The de Rham index character of a rotating two-sphere
items.statement: Assume countable choice. Give $S^2=\{(x,y,z)\in\mathbb R^3:x^2+y^2+z^2=1\}$ its outward orientation and the de Rham complex. Let $T=\mathbb R/\mathbb Z$ act by rotation through angle $2\pi s$ about the $z$-axis for $[s]\in T$. For every nonidentity $g=[s]$, the fixed set consists of the north and south poles. The de Rham index character is $2$, and the two isolated fixed-point contributions are each $1$.
